note: Copy to secret-config.json (git-ignored, chmod 600) and replace the values. slug: null makes publish.sh create a new here.now Site on first run. Real values are secrets: anyone with path_token + collection can read and write the data. retired_collections: old collection names after a rotation; build.py lists them as owner-only and never puts them in the app (tools/prepare-rotation.py fills this in).
